### 2026-10-07 – # Researching Parts

**1.8h**

# Researching Parts

Decided to go with the ESP32 C3 Supermini for the small size. Spent the session further researching other components. Thinking of including a battery system, so will still need to find the relevant parts.

### 2026-10-07 – # Did the bulk of the Schematic work

**3.68h**

# Did the bulk of the Schematic work

Finally finished researching components, and started laying things out in easyEDA.
Now at a stage I am happy with, but still have to add a few more components.

Hoping that from this point on its gets a bit easier, as so far its been pretty complicated. Although I spent way too long trying to figure out how to use pin headers, and it turns out you don't even need them lol (at least in the schematic).

![PCB Schematic v1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/QXCoV5Opaf2tVWRHLncynf97ZTE9HKDO/8d57acc4a0f5deee26658b55fcc6f958cbc1f2d7fc239c19368e5942ffccbe44.png)

### 2026-10-08 – # Simplifying the Schematic

**2.32h**

# Simplifying the Schematic

Spent this session researching the components more, and whether they would actually work together.

Found out that using mosfets to switch the charging off would be painful, so got rid of them.

Regarding this as a first PCB project, its going fairly well I think, but I'm still yet to actually get onto the PCB phase.

Still need to add ports for the temp sensor, but I think this is nearing the PCB wiring phase. But the project is likely too ambitious, as will still have to organise the BOM after that.

Current state of things:
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/QXCoV5Opaf2tVWRHLncynf97ZTE9HKDO/8b82489b87f5091e2c6964a42f49b6c2a7c543c4c817f1ed667ba8f414be34e4.png)

### 2026-10-09 – # Started Circuitry

**3.77h**

# Started Circuitry

Finally got the schematic to a stage that I was happy with:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/QXCoV5Opaf2tVWRHLncynf97ZTE9HKDO/e7627b642d1d90318439aed47692bdf6d092d7961bf00366f41a9054a32d6992.png)

Is a slightly older version, as I removed the 18650 holders from the PCB as I'm using through hole components.

Now I've got the fun task of learning how to wire up the board. I've started a bit on it, but I seems rather complicated, especially regarding the "ratsnest" of blue connecting lines.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/QXCoV5Opaf2tVWRHLncynf97ZTE9HKDO/94e05a7a6478ab8d47c2c7855e79bd69bab610de4d6184a5202a1cfaf46cc376.png)

But I've gotta say, it does look pretty sick, even though it isn't wired up yet.
